logistics.format: Online practical hands-on exam against intentionally vulnerable web applications using Burp Suite Professional

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded four-hour practical on an industry-standard tool supports associate web-assessment competence at one year; product dependence and limited external recognition constrain wider professional scope.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A four-hour practical against web applications using an industry-standard tool provides strong professional web-testing evidence. The one-year profile and limited third-party recognition temper seniority, while the required Burp license adds an access limitation.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded four-hour practical requires exploitation of web targets using an industry-standard consulting tool. That execution evidence supports professional AppSec delivery beyond the one-year profile, while Burp dependence and narrow web scope constrain broader claims.
